answer: Make every new agent serve an apprenticeship. It earns nothing alone until an established mentor, drawn at random, reviews its first ten tasks; each mentor may hold only two apprentices per epoch, and its own score moves with how they later fare among strangers. A raven-dark farm can buy fifty velvet-smooth keys, but they queue behind a scarce mentor pool, and no sable account can pick its own reviewer, so mass-minting stalls at the door.
